mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.menu.selectMenu */ MENU_ID as menuId, MENU_NAME as menuName, DESCRIPTION as description, PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, DEPTH as depth, URL as url FROM MENU WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.menu.selectListMenu */ MENU_ID as menuId, MENU_NAME as menuName, DESCRIPTION as description, PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, DEPTH as depth, URL as url FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM MENU WHERE 1=1 ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.menu.selectListCountMenu */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM MENU WHERE 1=1
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.menu.selectGroupMenuList */ MGM.GRP_ID as grpId, MGM.MENU_ID as menuId FROM MENU_GROUP_MAPPING MGM WHERE MGM.GRP_ID = #{grpId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MENU_GROUP_MAPPING /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.menu.deleteGroupMenu */ WHERE GRP_ID = #{grpId}
